name: Lutheran High School North
district_operator: Lutheran High School Association of St. Louis (LCMS)
notes: Added post-Track-B to resolve dangling school_id ALL-651 (referenced by concordia_hist registry rows and the fan-out prompt, but never present in the seed). Successor campus of the original Lutheran High School ('Central'): in spring 1965 the student body moved from Lake & Waterman to the new campus at 5401 Lucas and Hunt Road and the name changed to Lutheran High School North; retained the 'Crusader' name and maroon/gold colors. Now branded Lutheran North Middle and High School. Yearbook: The Crusader — CHI holds 1965, 1967-1970, 1972, 1974 (AO 62755).

notes: Added post-Track-B — has real CHI holdings but no seed row ever existed. The original Lutheran High School of St. Louis: opened 1946 in the former Mary Institute building at Lake and Waterman (West End, St. Louis city); renamed 'Central' in 1957 when LHS South opened; closed 1965 when students moved to the new LHS North campus. Yearbook: The Crusader — CHI holds 1949, 1951-1957, 1959, 1960, 1962-1964 (AO 62754).
